reproduction.description: Compare learned conditional structure, disjoint-test joint density, masked-cell cross entropy and Brier loss.
differences: Seeded synthetic data, not measurements from the named original benchmark.
Synthetic 240 train/120 test binary rows with 12 variables replace 20 Newsgroups documents and 100 word indicators.
Independence and two small mixture models replace the original large K mixture and binary/categorical-FA suites. No score for unimplemented FA models.
Only implemented learned conditional tables are visualized; no tree/DAG/MRF structures are claimed. Missing-cell scores use a missing-cell denominator.
